items.title: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
items.summary: The discovery of an unauthorized Ledger hardware implant reignited debate on whether Bitcoin ETFs are safer than self-custodying Bitcoin via hardware wallet devices.

items.title: Strategy adds 250 Bitcoin as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
items.summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy said Bitcoin holdings reached 848,250 BTC after its latest purchase, while maintaining a $4.88 billion cash reserve.

items.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
items.summary: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.

items.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
items.summary: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.
